name: core.openwop.workflows.campaign-brief
description: Campaign-brief messaging-kernel + market-intel workflows, migrated from the deprecated builtins (ADR 0472 P4). chainIds keep the original ids; outputRoles restored at registration.

chains.label: Messaging kernel
chains.description: Generate the campaign messaging kernel, then approve it — the foundation every channel echoes.

briefId.description: The campaign brief to generate the messaging kernel for.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes (for example anthropic, openai, google). Fixed into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave unset to keep the nodes' own default.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by `provider` in the host catalog. Set it together with `provider`.

config.prompt: Review the generated messaging kernel: the headline, supporting statement, proof points, CTAs and tone every channel will echo. It is saved to the brief only if you approve it; reject it and ask the Strategist to regenerate.

chains.label: Market intelligence
chains.description: Extract voice-of-customer → angles → targeting, then approve the intel.

platform.description: Targeting platform: meta | google | linkedin | tiktok.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes (for example anthropic, openai, google). Fixed into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave unset to keep the nodes' own default.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by `provider` in the host catalog. Set it together with `provider`.

config.prompt: Review the research: the evidence, angles and targeting pack are saved to the brief's Intel tab as they are found, and every item cites its source. Curate them there (delete what you don't want) before generating channel assets. Approving finishes this research run; rejecting removes nothing.
